perplexity.description:
The Apollo: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (2019) is a 32-track compilation album released by Blue Note Records and UMe to accompany the HBO documentary of the same name. The album showcases the rich musical legacy of Harlem’s Apollo Theater, blending classic jazz, soul, and R&B recordings with new original compositions and interview excerpts. Featured artists include jazz giants like Charles Mingus, Ella Fitzgerald, and Billie Holiday, alongside soul icons such as Marvin Gaye and James Brown. The soundtrack also highlights a new original song, “Don’t Turn Back Now,” performed by Robert Glasper with vocals by Ledisi, and selections from Glasper’s original score, which add a contemporary layer to the historic tapestry.

As a compilation by various artists, the album stands as a tribute to the Apollo Theater’s pivotal role in American music and culture, rather than as a traditional artist discography entry. Its musical style reflects the diversity of genres that have graced the Apollo stage, from big band jazz to Motown and beyond. The album received critical acclaim for its thoughtful curation and historical significance, praised for capturing both the sound and spirit of the Apollo’s legacy. Released digitally in November 2019 and on CD and vinyl in December 2019, the soundtrack was well-received for its seamless blend of classic recordings and new material, serving as both a companion to the documentary and a standalone celebration of African American musical heritage.
